pro_description.value: While your domain is active, you transform into a raging elemental. Choose a damage type (fire, cold, lighting, thunder, acid, poison, necrotic or radiant). You gain immunity to that type of damage while your domain is active. You gain temporary hit points equal to 10 times the amount of points invested in this node. You become immune to non-magical attacks and are resistant to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from magical attacks. You deal an additional 5 points damage of the selected damage type with melee attacks, increasing by 5 for every point invested. You gain a flying speed equal to your movement speed, increasing by 10ft per point. Your size increases by one stage per point invested. You deal an additional dice of damage with melee attacks for every point invested in this node.
